17struct ConstraintMonitorStats {
18 double max_H = 0.0;

25namespace constraint_monitor_detail {
26inline double det3(double gxx, double gxy, double gxz, double gyy, double gyz, double gzz) {
27 return gxx * (gyy * gzz - gyz * gyz) - gxy * (gxy * gzz - gxz * gyz) +
28 gxz * (gxy * gyz - gxz * gyy);
29}
30}

36template <typename T>
37inline ConstraintMonitorStats compute_constraint_monitor(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G,
38 const Field3D<T> &H, size_t padding = 4) {
39 ConstraintMonitorStats stats;
40
41 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
42 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
43
44 const size_t guard = std::max<size_t>(padding, size_t(2));
45 const size_t i0 = std::min(I0 + guard, I1);
46 const size_t j0 = std::min(J0 + guard, J1);
47 const size_t k0 = std::min(K0 + guard, K1);
48 const size_t i1 = (I1 > guard) ? I1 - guard : I1;
49 const size_t j1 = (J1 > guard) ? J1 - guard : J1;
50 const size_t k1 = (K1 > guard) ? K1 - guard : K1;
51
52 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
53 return stats;
54
55 double accum_H = 0.0;
56
57 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)
58 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j)
59 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
60 const size_t id = H.idx(i, j, k);
61 const double h = static_cast<double>(H.ptr()[id]);
62 stats.max_H = std::max(stats.max_H, std::abs(h));
63 accum_H += h * h;
64 stats.samples += 1;
65
66 const double gxx = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 0, 0);
67 const double gxy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 0, 1);
68 const double gxz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 0, 2);
69 const double gyy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 1, 1);
70 const double gyz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 1, 2);
71 const double gzz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde, id, 2, 2);
72 const double det_val = constraint_monitor_detail::det3(gxx, gxy, gxz, gyy, gyz, gzz);
73 stats.max_det_drift = std::max(stats.max_det_drift, std::abs(det_val - 1.0));
74
75 const double Axx = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 0, 0);
76 const double Axy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 0, 1);
77 const double Axz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 0, 2);
78 const double Ayy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 1, 1);
79 const double Ayz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 1, 2);
80 const double Azz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.A_tilde, id, 2, 2);
81
82 const double gixx = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 0, 0);
83 const double gixy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 0, 1);
84 const double gixz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 0, 2);
85 const double giyy = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 1, 1);
86 const double giyz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 1, 2);
87 const double gizz = tensorium_RG::sym6_get(G.gamma_tilde_inv, id, 2, 2);
88 const double trace = gixx * Axx + giyy * Ayy + gizz * Azz +
89 2.0 * (gixy * Axy + gixz * Axz + giyz * Ayz);
90 stats.max_trace_A = std::max(stats.max_trace_A, std::abs(trace));
91 }
92
93 if (stats.samples > 0)
94 stats.l2_H = std::sqrt(accum_H / static_cast<double>(stats.samples));
95 else
96 stats.l2_H = 0.0;
97
98 return stats;
99}

102inline void print_constraint_monitor(const ConstraintMonitorStats &stats,
103 const char *label = "constraints") {
104 std::printf("[%s] maxH=%.3e L2H=%.3e max|TrA|=%.3e max|det-1|=%.3e samples=%zu\n", label,
105 stats.max_H, stats.l2_H, stats.max_trace_A, stats.max_det_drift, stats.samples);
106}
